name: Indemnity Claim — Direct Debit Guarantee
description: PER-001 disputes a Direct Debit collection under the Direct Debit Guarantee. The customer contacts the bank via the mobile app, identifies the disputed collection, and files an indemnity claim. The bank credits the account immediately and unconditionally (regulatory obligation — DD Guarantee). SVC-009 then initiates BACS indemnity recovery from the originator. The customer also requests mandate cancellation. This scenario covers PH-051.
regulatory_context: The Direct Debit Guarantee gives customers an unconditional right to a full and immediate refund from their bank for any Direct Debit taken in error. No evidence or justification is required. The bank's obligation is absolute — it credits first, then recovers from the originator.
pre_conditions: PER-001 has an active DirectDebitInstruction (ENT-034, status=active) for BRITISH GAS
A DirectDebitCollection (ENT-035, status=collected) exists: £87.50 collected on 2026-05-15
Customer believes the collection was taken in error

steps.action: Navigate to Direct Debits → BRITISH GAS → Collection history → Select '£87.50 — 15 May 2026' → 'Dispute this payment'

Display DD Guarantee information: 'Under the Direct Debit Guarantee, you are entitled to a full and immediate refund of £87.50. No reason is required.' Display options: [Claim Refund] [Cancel mandate] checkbox
Confirm indemnity claim: reason='Amount taken was incorrect', mandate_cancel_requested=true. Submit claim.
POST /payments/v1/direct-debits/{ddi_id}/indemnity-claim { collection_id, claimed_amount: 87.50, claim_reason: 'Amount taken was incorrect', mandate_cancel_requested: true }
steps.note: Persona → Channel → CAP-003 Payment Operations API. SCA not required for indemnity claim — customer is already authenticated in session.

steps.action: 202 Accepted { claim_id: 'd1e2f3a4-...', collection_id, claimed_amount: 87.50, credit_sla: 'Your account will be credited within 30 seconds under the Direct Debit Guarantee', mandate_cancellation_status: 'cancellation_initiated' }
steps.note: SVC-009 creates indemnity claim record. Updates ENT-035.status = indemnity_claimed. Publishes EVT-074.

steps.action: Publish DirectDebitIndemnityClaimFiled (EVT-074) { claim_id, collection_id, ddi_id, account_id, claimed_amount: 87.50, mandate_cancel_requested: true }
steps.note: CRITICAL cross-capability event. SVC-001 must consume and process within 30 seconds (DD Guarantee 'immediate' credit obligation).

steps.action: Write EVT-074 to WORM audit log immediately (Consumer Duty and DD Guarantee evidence)
Show: 'Your claim has been submitted. £87.50 will be credited to your account within 30 seconds under the Direct Debit Guarantee. Your Direct Debit has been cancelled.'
Consume EVT-074 (HIGH PRIORITY consumer group — < 30 seconds SLA). Credit account £87.50 immediately. Idempotent on claim_id.
steps.timing: < 30 seconds from EVT-074 publication (DD Guarantee regulatory obligation)

steps.action: Publish AccountCredited { account_id, amount: 87.50, credit_type: 'dd_indemnity', claim_id, credited_at: '2026-04-15T10:30:18Z' }
Consume AccountCredited — confirm indemnity credit processed. Initiate BACS indemnity recovery from originator.
Submit BACS Indemnity Claim instruction to recover £87.50 from originator SUN 123456 (BRITISH GAS)
steps.note: Recovery from originator is a BACS scheme process — originator is liable. Bank has already credited customer unconditionally.

steps.action: Submit AUDDIS 0C (cancellation): cancel DDI for SUN 123456, reference BGS-001234567. Update ENT-034.status = cancelled.
steps.note: Mandate cancellation as requested by customer (mandate_cancel_requested=true in EVT-074)

steps.action: Consume AccountCredited → send indemnity confirmation to customer
Push + email: '£87.50 has been credited to your account under the Direct Debit Guarantee. Your Direct Debit with BRITISH GAS has been cancelled. BACS claim ref: BACS-IND-2026-04-15-001.'
Write AccountCredited event to WORM audit log (7-year retention — Consumer Duty complaint handling evidence)

outcome.customer_account_impact: £87.50 credited (net position: customer holds £87.50 additional funds)
outcome.bacs_recovery: Indemnity recovery claim submitted to originator (BRITISH GAS) via BACS scheme
outcome.elapsed_time: Account credit within 30 seconds of POST /indemnity-claim. Mandate cancellation within BACS T+0 window.

regulatory_notes: The DD Guarantee credit (step 9) is unconditional — the bank cannot delay pending investigation.
The bank recovers from the originator post-credit via the BACS indemnity scheme — the customer is not involved in this process.
No SCA is required for an indemnity claim — customer authentication (session token) is sufficient.
The WORM audit log entry (step 7) must be created before the API returns 202 to ensure evidence is captured even if downstream processing fails.
